description: List an item's comments. List the comment thread on a queue item, oldest first. Each comment carries its author (a teammate email, or `system` for a comment authored by Jarvis — the AI agent), its markdown body, and `parentId` for the single level of threaded replies. Removed comments are omitted.

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

name: ops_comments_list
